entities.summary: Tito Paris (b. 1963-05-30, Mindelo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mindelo and Cape Verde. Known in the fields of cape verde, composers & musicians, africa.
